services.name: Admissions
services.desc: Our main admissions desk is located at 88 Brunel Road, Huntsville, Ontario - 1 kilometre from downtown Huntsville and minutes from Hwys 60 and 11. Muskoka Museum is open all year round with free admission mid-October to mid-May. The Portage Flyer Train and Pioneer Village are open from May 16, 2026 to October 10, 2026. You may purchase tickets for the Portage Flyer Train and Steam Museum at Rotary Village Station or our main admissions desk. The station opens one hour prior to first departure for ticket sales. Arrive at least 15 minutes before departure times. Tickets can only be purchased at the time of arrival - no online or advance tickets

services.name: Historical Walking Tours
services.desc: Step into Huntsville's storied past this fall with Cemetery Tales, part of our walking tour series! These immersive tours blend historical accuracy and storytelling, bringing to life the tales of the people and events that shaped our town. services.name: Rental
services.desc: For your wedding or other private event, Muskoka Heritage Place has many options to explore. Site rentals are available year-round after our regular hours of operation.
